record_title: Affine-lattice box optimality of an integer equivelar octahedron of genus 3
limitations: Optimality is proved only within the affine class of Mizhaev's displayed realization under the requirement that all transformed vertices remain integral; global coordinate minimality among all realizations is not established. The full text of the 2020 precursor was unavailable for inspection, and the 2026 preprint is very recent.

artifact_inventory.purpose: Exact integer verification of lattice-saturation minors, coordinate ranges, forcing differences, and the attained bounding-box volume product.
